newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open mostly flat Tuesday, dealers said, with trade expected to remain rangebound and thin ahead of the May contract's expiry Wednesday.
Nearby support was seen at 11.00 cents a lb for July delivery and then at 10.91, the recent low. Traders pegged resistance at 11.18-11.20.
Monday, the most-active month finished down 0.07 cent at 11.07 cents after trading from 11.12 to 11.01 cents. Spot May eased 0.06 to 11.49, while back months slipped 0.06 to 0.03.

Sucden-Moskva, a major importer of Cuban raw sugar into Russia, could import 400,000 tonnes of raws in 1997 compared with about 250,000 last year, according to a company official quoted by Prime-Tass news agency. Company officials in Moscow were not able to confirm the figure, however.
Warm, dry weather is expected to return to Europe after recent rains, meteorologists said.

LIFFE white sugar futures were weaker in dull trade Tuesday as the whites market kept an eye on New York. At 0845 EDT/1345 GMT, August stood down 10 cents to $313.00, while the back months were unchanged.
((-- S Rostler New York Commodity Desk, 212-859-1640))
